{{Top|leg}}
'''En'Tra'Tal''' was the [[Capital/Legends|capital]] [[City/Legends|city]] of the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] of [[Coyn]]. Translated into [[Galactic Basic Standard/Legends|Basic]], the name meant "King-City." En'Tra'Tal contained the [[Rols'Kus]] or "Arena of the Games" and the [[Arquas'Tais]], the "Land of Fallen Ones of Valor", was located just outside the city. En'Tra'Tais or "Kingland" was a stellar class [[Spaceport/Legends|spaceport]] and largest on the planet that was also located in the city.
